planned_deliverables.deliverable_summary: The finished hook-driven article carrying the muddy-shoe question through to changed noticing.
Inline photo of the muddy shoe print at the bed edge, placed at the hook.
Inline photo of the coiled hose left ready, placed at the reframing turn.

shared_references.continuity_role: Fixes which maintenance signs count as evidence, so the prose and the photos point at the same unseen labor.

effective_project_scale.rationale: The article is one structured artifact and the supporting photos are compact, so the project inherits the article's structured single-artifact scale.

production_order.step_summary: Realize the primary article so its accepted prose fixes where photos belong and what they must show.
Plan and place the two supporting inline photos against the accepted article realization.

shared_meaning_rules: Both media hold attention on maintenance as unseen labor; neither names a hero or thanks anyone by name.
allowed_variation: The photos may show a different bed than the prose describes, as long as the maintenance sign is the same kind.
must_not_drift: Neither medium may resolve the question into praise, complaint, or a call to volunteer.

traceability_summary.note: Production order and photo placement trace to the approved hook, turn, and payoff beats; the Beat Plan is reused unchanged.
Primary article and supporting photos both serve noticing the labor that keeps a shared garden usable.
The existing Text Medium Plan is the primary realization the supporting image medium takes continuity from.
